title: AI job application tools backfire for graduates
excerpt: Research shows graduates are increasingly using AI to misrepresent themselves in high-volume job applications, potentially causing issues.
body_html:
Recent research indicates that graduates are increasingly turning to artificial intelligence to assist with job applications. Many are using these tools in a manner that can misrepresent themselves to potential employers.

While some applicants feel driven to use automated or bulk application methods because of the intense competition they face, experts and findings suggest that this heavy reliance on AI can ultimately backfire for job seekers.
